# subsetting max 5 samples per dataset to test

```{r}
set.seed(42)

#Pick up to n samples per object. method = "largest" stress-tests with your
#biggest samples first (catches hangs/OOM fastest); "random" gives a more
#§representative but less adversarial test.
subset_max_samples <- function(obj, n = 2, method = c("largest", "random")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  stopifnot("sample" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))

  tab <- table(obj$sample)
  tab <- tab[tab > 0]

  chosen <- if (method == "largest") {
    names(sort(tab, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(n, length(tab)))]
  } else {
    sample(names(tab), min(n, length(tab)))
  }

  message(sprintf("%-12s: %d -> %d samples | %d -> %d cells",
                   unique(obj$Dataset), length(tab), length(chosen),
                   ncol(obj), sum(tab[chosen])))

  cells_keep <- colnames(obj)[obj$sample %in% chosen]
  subset(obj, cells = cells_keep)
}
``` 

# Map the atlas then add MT

# using log tranform

```{r}


common_genes_mac <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    rownames(MT_data),
    rownames(Reichart_data),
    rownames(Chaffin_data),
    rownames(Litvinukova_data),
    rownames(DCM_data)
  )
)


###################################### merge

DefaultAssay(Reichart_data) <- "RNA"

macrophage_merged_background <- merge(
  x = Reichart_data,
  y = list(Chaffin_data, Litvinukova_data, DCM_data, MT_data),
  add.cell.ids = c("Reichart", "Chaffin", "Litvinukova", "DCM", "MT"),
  project = "Merged_Macrophage_Atlas"
)

# Clean workspace memory
rm(Reichart_data, Chaffin_data, Litvinukova_data, DCM_data)
#gc()

macrophage_merged_background <- macrophage_merged_background[common_genes_mac, ]
macrophage_merged_background
table(macrophage_merged_background$sample)


# Join RNA layers if split
if (length(grep("^counts", Layers(macrophage_merged_background[["RNA"]]))) > 1) {
  macrophage_merged_background[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(macrophage_merged_background[["RNA"]])
}

###################################### mrun log transform on background

macrophage_merged_background <- NormalizeData(macrophage_merged_background)
macrophage_merged_background <- FindVariableFeatures(macrophage_merged_background, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
Features <- VariableFeatures(macrophage_merged_background)

macrophage_merged_background <- ScaleData(macrophage_merged_background, features = Features, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")

###################################### PCA and Harmony
 

pcs <- 20

macrophage_merged_background <- RunPCA(macrophage_merged_background, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

macrophage_merged_background <- RunUMAP(macrophage_merged_background, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs)

DimPlot(macrophage_merged_background, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("Dataset", "condition"))

# Group ONLY by Dataset to avoid stripping patient/disease variation

macrophage_merged_harmony <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  object           = macrophage_merged_background,
  assay.use        = "RNA",
  group.by.vars    = c("Dataset"),      
  dims.use         = 1:pcs,             
  plot_convergence = FALSE
)

macrophage_merged_harmony <- RunUMAP(macrophage_merged_harmony, reduction = "harmony",
  return.model = TRUE, dims = 1:pcs)

macrophage_merged_harmony <- FindNeighbors(macrophage_merged_harmony, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:pcs)

macrophage_merged_harmony <- FindClusters(macrophage_merged_harmony, resolution = 0.1)

DimPlot(macrophage_merged_harmony, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("Dataset", "condition"))
DimPlot(macrophage_merged_harmony, reduction = "umap", group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1")

Data3D <- RunUMAP(
  macrophage_merged_harmony, 
  dims = 1:pcs,                
  n.components = 3, reduction = "harmony",          # Generate 3 dimensions (UMAP_1, UMAP_2, UMAP_3)
  reduction.name = "umap3d"
)
# Extract 3D UMAP embeddings and cell metadata
umap3d_df <- data.frame(
  Embeddings(Data3D, "umap3d"),
  cluster = Data3D$RNA_snn_res.0.1,
  Dataset = Data3D$Dataset,
  condition = Data3D$condition
)

library(plotly)
# Plot interactive 3D scatter plot
plot_ly(
  umap3d_df, 
  x = ~umap3d_1, 
  y = ~umap3d_2, 
  z = ~umap3d_3, 
  color = ~condition, 
  type = "scatter3d", 
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 3, opacity = 0.8)
) 



```

```{r}


##################################  Clean the UMAP from before

#macrophage_clean <- subset(macrophage_merged_harmony, idents = c(0, 1, 2))
macrophage_clean <- macrophage_merged_harmony
variableFeatures <- VariableFeatures(macrophage_clean)
macrophage_clean <- FindVariableFeatures(macrophage_clean, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
macrophage_clean <- ScaleData(macrophage_clean, features = variableFeatures, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")
macrophage_clean <- RunPCA(macrophage_clean, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

macrophage_clean <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  object        = macrophage_clean,
  assay.use     = "RNA",
  group.by.vars = "Dataset",
  dims.use      = 1:pcs,
  plot_convergence = FALSE
)

macrophage_clean <- RunUMAP(
  macrophage_clean,
  reduction    = "harmony",
  return.model = TRUE,      
  dims         = 1:pcs
)

# Re-cluster clean reference
macrophage_clean <- FindNeighbors(macrophage_clean, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:pcs)
macrophage_clean <- FindClusters(macrophage_clean, resolution = 0.1)

########## prep MT data log 


MT_data <- MT_data[common_genes_mac, ]

MT_data_norm <- NormalizeData(MT_data, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

DefaultAssay(MT_data_norm) <- "RNA"

#################################################

transfer_anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference            = macrophage_clean,
  query                = MT_data_norm,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  reference.reduction  = "pca",       
  reduction            = "pcaproject",
  dims                 = 1:pcs,
  verbose              = TRUE
)


MT_mapped <- MapQuery(
  anchorset           = transfer_anchors,
  reference           = macrophage_clean,
  query               = MT_data_norm,
  refdata             = list(cell_type_pred = "RNA_snn_res.0.1"),
  reference.reduction = "harmony",       
  reduction.model     = "umap"
)

####################### plotting

p1 <- DimPlot(
  macrophage_clean,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by  = "RNA_snn_res.0.1",
  label     = TRUE
) + ggtitle("Clean Primary Reference Atlas")

p2 <- DimPlot(
  MT_mapped,
  reduction = "ref.umap",
  group.by  = "predicted.cell_type_pred",
  label     = TRUE
) + ggtitle("Mapped MT_Data Query (LogNormalize)")

p1 
p2
```
